author: Caleb
description: Judges every incoming message with TypeSafe's jev-latest System One model via its native API before the chat plugin runs, and marks messages worth replying to as mentioned.

zh.description: 在聊天插件之前，通过 TypeSafe 原生 System One 接口使用 jev-latest 模型判断每条收到的消息是否应该触发回复，需要回复时将 is_mentioned 置为 True。
